_meta.description: Pilot Battle Plans for Next.js — refs must exist in canon-daily-verse.json (today + catalog).

plans.title: Fear toward faith
plans.tagline: Seven gentle KJV stops when your chest is tight — pick up where you left off, no pressure.

days.gentleNote: Fear doesn’t mean you failed — it means you’re human. Start with His nearness.
Dark valleys are named; so is His company.
Broken hearts aren’t hidden from Him.
Come as you are — heavy is allowed.
Prayer beats spinning alone.
His peace isn’t the world’s cheap calm.
What feels permanent may move — His kindness doesn’t.

plans.title: Parenting in faith
plans.tagline: For the long days — one verse a day, table-ready when you need it.

days.gentleNote: Cast the mental load — He cares.
Exhaustion is an invitation to come.
When the house is loud, peace can still post guard.
Strength for the next bedtime, the next meal.
Valley days with littles count too.
Courage for the step after the meltdown.
His peace isn’t tied to a perfect home.

plans.title: Grief toward hope
plans.tagline: Honest sadness, held by Scripture — review when you can.

days.gentleNote: Near, not far — especially now.
Grief is heavy; He says come.
The valley is real; so is the Shepherd.
Let not your heart be troubled — addressed, not dismissed.
Cast the weight; let Him sustain.
Tears and prayer can share the same breath.
Covenant peace when everything else shifts.

plans.title: Family worship in the trenches
plans.tagline: Short, repeatable KJV anchors for the table or the car line.

days.gentleNote: Start simple: Jesus invites tired people.
Courage for new seasons together.
Even kids understand “He’s with me.”
Model honest prayer without performance.
Peace as a family gift, not a score.
Share the habit of handing cares to God.
Wait on Him together — no rush.
